MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

5. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   D. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

12. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
